brief: Jeanie Buss asked a judge to block her siblings from selling their 17.8% Lakers stake, alleging a secret plot to push her out as governor.
Week 2 left several teams, including the Timberwolves, Pacers and Raptors, without star players for extended periods. Anthony Edwards and Kawhi Leonard are named in the headline.
The Spurs beat the Timberwolves 121-111 behind a big game from Victor Wembanyama.
Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. became the NBA's first teenager to hit nine 3-pointers in a game, and the 76ers beat the Hornets 109-104 with Tyrese Maxey scoring 38.

stories.headline: Jeanie Buss asks judge to block siblings from selling 17.8% Lakers stake
stories.summary: Jeanie Buss is asking a judge to stop her siblings from selling their 17.8% stake in the Los Angeles Lakers. She says the sale would force her out as team governor. A related report describes it as her third Buss family court filing since August and quotes her alleging a "false flag operation" by her siblings.
stories.whyItMatters: The dispute could affect who controls one of the NBA's best-known franchises.
stories.rationale: A major ownership and governance story. I chose this version for its detail on the stake and the governor role, and left out the duplicate report.

stories.headline: Week 2 injuries sideline Anthony Edwards, Kawhi Leonard and other stars
stories.summary: A Yahoo Sports roundup says the Timberwolves, Pacers and Raptors are among the teams that must account for star players sidelined for extended periods after Week 2. The headline names Anthony Edwards and Kawhi Leonard among those added to the injury list. The excerpt gives no details on the injuries or timelines.
stories.whyItMatters: Extended absences by star players can change team outlooks early in the season.
stories.rationale: Injuries to prominent players affect several teams, so the roundup is consequential. The excerpt is thin, so the summary stays limited to what it states.

stories.headline: Spurs beat Timberwolves 121-111 as Wembanyama dominates
stories.summary: The San Antonio Spurs beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 121-111. The recap credits a monster performance from Victor Wembanyama. A separate highlights item says he scored the second-most points in a game in his career, and it also credits Fox and Harper for the win.
stories.whyItMatters: A star performance in a notable matchup, and a loss for a Timberwolves team also named in the injury roundup.
stories.rationale: An important game with a standout individual showing. I chose the recap with the final score over the duplicate highlights item.

stories.headline: Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. is first NBA teenager to hit nine 3-pointers in a game
stories.summary: Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. became the first teenager in NBA history to make nine 3-pointers in a game. The excerpt says he has been busy in his first couple of weeks in the league.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a league-history milestone for a rookie early in his career.
stories.rationale: A clear record-setting achievement with lasting interest.

stories.headline: Maxey scores 38 as 76ers beat Hornets 109-104 with Jaylen Brown back
stories.summary: Tyrese Maxey scored 38 points in the 76ers' 109-104 win over the Hornets. Jaylen Brown returned to the lineup after missing Friday's win over the Knicks with left patellar tendinopathy. He started slowly but finished with 16 points. A separate item credits VJ Edgecombe with a big late shot in the comeback.
stories.whyItMatters: Brown's return from a knee issue and Maxey's scoring mattered in a close win.
stories.rationale: A close game with a notable player return and injury context. I merged the duplicate coverage of the same game.
